subject: Error in -remove_idx : invalid argument to unary operator

messages.subject: Error in -remove_idx : invalid argument to unary operator
parts:
Dear users,
I'm running several simulations at the same time under lavaan. First, I create the data fitting the relations between variables and then I fit several models and automatically run a 'backward model selection'. That is, to exclude the path with highest P-value and compete between new and origin model.
 
From the more than 50 different ones, in 2-3 of them I receive the message "Error in -remove_idx : invalid argument to unary operator" and the simulation collapse, 
I'm not sure whether this is a problem of the process or is a specific lavaan warning, can you help me with that?

Thanks, any recommendation would de useful
